info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Documents-v3-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Document Retrieval API provides users with the ability to access and retrieve documents related to specific insurance claims. This endpoint enables insurers, adjusters, and other stakeholders to efficiently access vital documentation associated with claims during the review or audit process. Use cases include tracking the status of claims, verifying submitted documents, and facilitating faster claims resolution. The API enhances operational efficiency by streamlining document access for authorized consumers.
